campaign_audit_phase.note: every one of the 1,233 unique inventory items now carries exactly one depth-standard judgment with mechanically verified evidence; the S36 decision ledger can open on a complete input

method.design: full-cluster census (no sampling): all 374 unique remaining-cluster items judged once each
method.denominator_note: 374 unique items = 81 MAPDIG + 91 MATHSOLVER + 78 WEATHER + 97 NLME + 35 MASTER-INDEX − 19 intra-set cross-cluster duplicates (F-0049 union accounting)
method.carry_over: 29 items with prior canonical judgments carried over verbatim per F-0048 (23 from MEDNLP/2D3D, 6 from SYNPATH)
method.groups: 36 bounded subagent groups (max 18 items; grouped by first-matching cluster + section, sections never merged; MASTER-INDEX fields under a pseudo-section)
method.judges: 36 independent general-purpose subagents (35 first-run clean; group-23 first launch failed with an infrastructure timeout before writing anything — relaunched cleanly and completed, documented per the s30 precedent; no partial/corrupt output was ever accepted)
method.depth_standard: campaign plan section 5 (what it is / why it exists / how it works conceptually / relations to other concepts; project usage not required for 'covered'); broad MASTER-INDEX field labels additionally require the vault to span the field's core with the cited note as a genuine anchor
method.evidence_rule: covered/equivalent/partial require a verbatim quote (>= 12 words for covered/equivalent) mechanically validated as a whitespace-normalized substring of the cited note (scripts/s35_validate_judgments.py, exit 0: 374/374 PASSED)

orchestrator_rereview.method: stratified even-spaced sample (every 9th record of the 374 = 42 items, 11.2%) spanning all 5 clusters (MAPDIG 9, MATHSOLVER 10, WEATHER 9, NLME 10, MASTER-INDEX 4) and all 4 verdicts (9 absent / 12 covered / 10 equivalent / 11 partial): 9 absent verified by independent orchestrator greps over all 544 notes (LightGlue/multi-image consensus/overlap detection/logarithmic equation/finite difference/lag feature/detail coefficient/arc fault/voltage sag/graph learning/node embedding/link prediction/geometric deep learning all 0 occurrences; 'superglue' 3 hits = the SuperGLUE benchmark in T5.md and 'short-circuit' 2 hits = ResNet-skip and sampling metaphors — both read and confirmed false positives exactly as the judges documented); 22 covered/equivalent/partial verified by reading cited destinations and judging the verdict + quote depth against the campaign depth standard
orchestrator_rereview.notes: Notable confirmed judgment calls: INT-0461 Autoregressive Language Modeling EQUIVALENT via CLM (the Decoder-Only note itself states 'also called autoregressive language modeling'); INT-0488 Error-Correcting Memory Updates EQUIVALENT via DeltaNet's delta rule; INT-0533 Segmented Recurrence Training EQUIVALENT via Transformer-XL's gradient-detached segment cache; INT-0506 Neural Memory Bank EQUIVALENT via MemGPT's external context; INT-0585 Transformers + INT-0594 Neural Memory COVERED as broad field labels with genuine anchors (Attention MOC; DeltaNet and Titans' dedicated neural-memory section); all 11 sampled partials confirmed as below-depth-but-present (padding-mask aside, point-prompt Q&A mention, polygonization gap, XGBoost+NN stacking bullet, RWKV read-out formula, Titans surprise updates, LoCoMo/LongMemEval mentions, head-replacement exemplar, window-of-history baseline, sequence-level loss aside, sin/cos-for-positions). All 9 sampled absent verdicts confirmed.

limitations: single-judge-per-item design mitigated by mandatory multi-term search before absent verdicts + the 11.2% orchestrator re-review; borderline covered/partial/equivalent calls carry uncertainty noted by judges
judgments reflect the vault as of session 34 state (no vault mutations occurred during judging)
'covered' does not include project usage; project context integration happens in the S37+ execution waves
